{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read the data to start fresh
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the contract: population is treatment group with complete data
# First, identify complete cases in baseline and final biomarker
complete_cases = df['biomarker_baseline'].notnull() & df['biomarker_final'].notnull()

# Filter to treatment group and complete cases
df_filtered = df[complete_cases & (df['arm'] == 'treatment')]

# Check sex distribution
print('Sex distribution in filtered population:')
print(df_filtered['sex'].value_counts())

# Check if any -999.0 remains in baseline
has_sentinel = (df_filtered['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum()
print(f'Number of -999.0 baseline values in filtered population: {has_sentinel}')"}
